mappings.description: HRH enables CanIf to use BasicCAN or FullCAN reception and to indicate a received L-SDU to the target upper layer module
HRH referencing a BasicCAN reception unit shall enable software filtering in CanIf
HTH enables CanIf to use BasicCAN or FullCAN transmission and to confirm a transmitted L-SDU to the target upper layer module
CanIf shall use all HRHs and HTHs of one CanDrv as a common single numbering area starting with zero
CanIf shall configure and store a software acceptance filter for each BasicCAN HRH via CanIfHrhSoftwareFilter
CanIf shall execute the software acceptance filter for the HRH passed by CanIf_RxIndication()
CanIf shall compare CanIfRxPduCanId and CanIfRxPduCanIdType against the received Mailbox->CanId to select the correct reception L-SDU
If the PDU channel mode is CANIF_OFFLINE, CanIf shall report CANIF_E_STOPPED and CanIf_Transmit() shall return E_NOT_OK
CanIf_Init() shall initialize the global variables and data structures of the CanIf including flags and buffers
During initialization CanIf shall switch every channel to CANIF_OFFLINE
CanIf_Init() shall initialize every Transmit L-PDU Buffer assigned to CanIf
CanIf_SetControllerMode() shall call Can_SetControllerMode() for the requested CAN controller
Invalid ControllerId in CanIf_SetControllerMode() shall report CANIF_E_PARAM_CONTROLLERID
Invalid ControllerMode in CanIf_SetControllerMode() shall report CANIF_E_PARAM_CTRLMODE
Invalid ControllerId in CanIf_GetControllerMode() shall report CANIF_E_PARAM_CONTROLLERID
Invalid ControllerModePtr in CanIf_GetControllerMode() shall report CANIF_E_PARAM_POINTER
If controller is in CAN_CS_STOPPED and the TxPdu is assigned to it, CanIf_Transmit() shall not call Can_Write() and shall return E_NOT_OK
CanIf_SetControllerMode(ControllerId, CAN_CS_SLEEP) shall set the PDU channel mode of the corresponding channel to CANIF_OFFLINE
CanIf_SetControllerMode(ControllerId, CAN_CS_STOPPED) or CanIf_ControllerBusOff() shall set the PDU channel mode to CANIF_TX_OFFLINE
CANIF_OFFLINE mode shall prevent Tx forwarding, clear Tx buffers, and suppress all Rx and Tx callback invocations
CANIF_TX_OFFLINE mode shall prevent Tx forwarding and clear Tx buffers while enabling Rx indication callbacks
CANIF_ONLINE mode shall enable Tx forwarding and all Rx and Tx callback invocations
CANIF_TX_OFFLINE_ACTIVE mode shall invoke TxConfirmation callbacks immediately on CanIf_Transmit() instead of buffering or forwarding to CanDrv
CanIf shall not prohibit the BusOff notification for Tx L-PDUs still pending in the CAN HW Object after a mode change to CANIF_TX_OFFLINE or CANIF_OFFLINE
Invalid ControllerId in CanIf_SetPduMode() shall report CANIF_E_PARAM_CONTROLLERID
Invalid PduModeRequest in CanIf_SetPduMode() shall report CANIF_E_PARAM_PDU_MODE
CanIf_SetPduMode() shall not accept any request and shall return E_NOT_OK if the controller mode is not CAN_CS_STARTED
Invalid ControllerId in CanIf_GetPduMode() shall report CANIF_E_PARAM_CONTROLLERID
Invalid PduModePtr in CanIf_GetPduMode() shall report CANIF_E_PARAM_POINTER
CanIf_Transmit() shall not accept a request if the controller mode is not CAN_CS_STARTED and the channel transmit path is not online or offline-active
CanIf_Transmit() shall call Can_Write() with the HTH, swPduHandle set to CanTxPduId, length, CanId, and SduDataPtr from PduInfoPtr
CanIf shall set the two MSBs of the CanId before calling Can_Write() based on CanIfTxPduCanIdType
CanIf_Transmit() shall return E_OK if Can_Write() returns E_OK
Invalid TxPduId in CanIf_Transmit() shall report CANIF_E_INVALID_TXPDUID
Invalid PduInfoPtr in CanIf_Transmit() shall report CANIF_E_PARAM_POINTER
CanIf_Transmit() shall accept a NULL SduDataPtr if CanIfTxPduTriggerTransmit is TRUE
CanIf_Transmit() shall report CANIF_E_DATA_LENGTH_MISMATCH if SduLength exceeds the maximum CAN or CAN FD frame length
CanIf_Transmit() shall transmit data up to the global PDU length and discard the rest when CanIfTxPduTruncation is enabled
CanIf_Transmit() shall report CANIF_E_TXPDU_LENGTH_EXCEEDED and return E_NOT_OK if SduLength exceeds the global PDU length and CanIfTxPduTruncation is disabled
If Can_Write() returns CAN_BUSY for a direct Tx PDU, CanIf shall attempt to store the Tx L-PDU in the assigned CanIfTxBuffer
If Can_Write() returns CAN_BUSY for a triggered Tx PDU, CanIf shall attempt to store the Transmit Request in the assigned CanIfTxBuffer
During TxConfirmation CanIf shall evaluate whether pending Tx L-PDUs or Transmit Requests are stored in the CanIfTxBuffers assigned to the freed HTH
On entering CAN_CS_STOPPED CanIf shall clear the Tx buffers assigned to the corresponding CAN Controller
On entering CAN_CS_STOPPED CanIf shall call <User_TxConfirmation>(E_NOT_OK) for every outstanding TxConfirmation assigned to that controller
CanIf_TxConfirmation() shall identify the upper layer linked to the transmitted L-PDU and notify it via <User_TxConfirmation>(E_OK)
If CanIf is not initialized, CanIf_TxConfirmation() shall not call <User_TxConfirmation>() or set the Tx confirmation status
Invalid CanTxPduId in CanIf_TxConfirmation() shall report CANIF_E_PARAM_LPDU
If CanIfTxPduUserTxConfirmationUL is set to CDD, the <User_TxConfirmation>() API name shall be configured via CanIfTxPduUserTxConfirmationName
CanIf_RxIndication() shall process software filtering on the received L-PDU; if rejected, the receive indication shall end for that call
After software filtering acceptance in CanIf_RxIndication(), CanIf shall process the Data Length Check if configured
If the received L-PDU CanId is configured to be received, CanIf shall accept it and derive the corresponding Rx L-PDU from the found CanId
Software filter shall prefer a single CanId over a range and a smaller range over a larger one when selecting the matching Rx L-PDU
CanIf shall accept received L-PDUs with a Data Length equal or greater than the configured CanIfRxPduDataLength value
Data Length Check shall be processed only if enabled globally via CanIfPrivateDataLengthCheck and not disabled per PDU via CanIfRxPduDataLengthCheck
If the Data Length Check rejects a received L-PDU, CanIf shall report CANIF_E_INVALID_DATA_LENGTH
CanIf shall pass the received length value to the target upper layer module if the Data Length Check is passed
CanIf shall pass the received length value to the target upper layer module if the Data Length Check is not configured
After Data Length Check acceptance, CanIf shall identify whether a target upper layer module is configured to receive the Rx indication
CanIf shall call the configured receive indication callback service with parameters derived from CanIf_RxIndication()
Within CanIf_RxIndication() CanIf shall route the indication to the configured upper layer target service
Invalid Mailbox->Hoh passed to CanIf_RxIndication() shall report CANIF_E_PARAM_HOH
Invalid Mailbox->CanId passed to CanIf_RxIndication() shall report CANIF_E_PARAM_CANID
Invalid PduInfoPtr or Mailbox passed to CanIf_RxIndication() shall report CANIF_E_PARAM_POINTER
If CanIf is not initialized, CanIf_RxIndication() shall not execute Rx indication handling
Each Rx L-PDU shall be configured with a corresponding receive indication service of an upper layer module called in CanIf_RxIndication()
The name of the <User_RxIndication>() API called by CanIf shall be configured via CanIfRxPduUserRxIndicationName
If CanIfRxPduUserRxIndicationUL is set to PDUR, CanIfRxPduUserRxIndicationName must be PduR_CanIfRxIndication
If CanIfRxPduUserRxIndicationUL is set to CAN_NM, CanIfRxPduUserRxIndicationName must be CanNm_RxIndication
If CanIfRxPduUserRxIndicationUL is set to CAN_TP, CanIfRxPduUserRxIndicationName must be CanTp_RxIndication
If CanIfRxPduUserRxIndicationUL is set to J1939TP, CanIfRxPduUserRxIndicationName must be J1939Tp_RxIndication
If CanIfRxPduUserRxIndicationUL is set to CDD, the <User_RxIndication>() API name shall be configured via CanIfRxPduUserRxIndicationName
CanIf_ReadRxPduData() shall return E_NOT_OK if the controller is not in CAN_CS_STARTED or the channel is not in Rx-online mode
Invalid CanIfRxSduId in CanIf_ReadRxPduData() shall report CANIF_E_INVALID_RXPDUID
Invalid CanIfRxInfoPtr in CanIf_ReadRxPduData() shall report CANIF_E_PARAM_POINTER
CanIf_ReadTxNotifStatus() shall reset the Tx notification status when CanIfPublicReadTxPduNotifyStatusApi and CanIfTxPduReadNotifyStatus are TRUE
Out-of-range or unconfigured CanIfTxSduId in CanIf_ReadTxNotifStatus() shall report CANIF_E_INVALID_TXPDUID
CanIf_ReadRxNotifStatus() shall reset the Rx notification status when CanIfPublicReadRxPduNotifyStatusApi and CanIfRxPduReadNotifyStatus are TRUE
Out-of-range or unconfigured CanIfRxSduId in CanIf_ReadRxNotifStatus() shall report CANIF_E_INVALID_RXPDUID
CanIf shall process the two MSBs of the CanId to determine the CanId type and how the dynamic Tx L-PDU shall be transmitted
CanIf shall guarantee CanId data consistency in CanIf_SetDynamicTxId() against pre-emptive CanIf_Transmit() calls on the same L-PDU
Invalid CanIfTxSduId in CanIf_SetDynamicTxId() shall report CANIF_E_INVALID_TXPDUID
Invalid CanId in CanIf_SetDynamicTxId() shall report CANIF_E_PARAM_CANID
If CanIf is not initialized, CanIf_SetDynamicTxId() shall not execute Tx CanId reconfiguration
CanIf_ControllerBusOff() shall call CanSM_ControllerBusOff() or a CDD when a BusOff event is indicated by CanDrv
Invalid ControllerId in CanIf_ControllerBusOff() shall report CANIF_E_PARAM_CONTROLLERID
If CanIf is not initialized, CanIf_ControllerBusOff() shall not execute BusOff notification
CanIf_CheckWakeup() shall query CanDrvs and CanTrcvs via Can_CheckWakeup() or CanTrcv_CheckWakeup() to identify the wake-up source
CanIf_CheckWakeup() shall return E_NOT_OK if all Can_CheckWakeup()/CanTrcv_CheckWakeup() calls return E_NOT_OK
<User_ValidateWakeupEvent>(sources) shall be called during CanIf_CheckValidation() if the first valid RxIndication event is stored for the corresponding controller
On entering CAN_CS_SLEEP the stored first-valid-RxIndication wake-up event shall be cleared
Invalid WakeupSource in CanIf_CheckWakeup() shall report CANIF_E_PARAM_WAKEUPSOURCE
Invalid WakeupSource in CanIf_CheckValidation() shall report CANIF_E_PARAM_WAKEUPSOURCE
CanIf_SetTrcvMode() shall call CanTrcv_SetOpMode(Transceiver, OpMode) on the corresponding transceiver driver
Invalid TransceiverId in CanIf_SetTrcvMode() shall report CANIF_E_PARAM_TRCV
Invalid TransceiverMode in CanIf_SetTrcvMode() shall report CANIF_E_PARAM_TRCVMODE
CanIf_GetTrcvMode() shall call CanTrcv_GetOpMode(Transceiver, OpMode) on the corresponding transceiver driver
Invalid TransceiverId in CanIf_GetTrcvMode() shall report CANIF_E_PARAM_TRCV
Invalid TransceiverModePtr in CanIf_GetTrcvMode() shall report CANIF_E_PARAM_POINTER
CanIf_GetTrcvWakeupReason() shall call CanTrcv_GetBusWuReason(Transceiver, Reason) on the corresponding transceiver driver
Invalid TransceiverId in CanIf_GetTrcvWakeupReason() shall report CANIF_E_PARAM_TRCV
Invalid TrcvWuReasonPtr in CanIf_GetTrcvWakeupReason() shall report CANIF_E_PARAM_POINTER
CanIf_SetTrcvWakeupMode() shall call CanTrcv_SetWakeupMode(Transceiver, TrcvWakeupMode) on the corresponding transceiver driver
Invalid TransceiverId in CanIf_SetTrcvWakeupMode() shall report CANIF_E_PARAM_TRCV
Invalid TrcvWakeupMode in CanIf_SetTrcvWakeupMode() shall report CANIF_E_PARAM_TRCVWAKEUPMODE
